speaker: AXIOM-7
text: AXIOM-7: Thermal telemetry online. Ambient temperature four thousand Kelvin. We have reached the sub-surface industrial rift: The Foundry Forge.

speaker: KAITO
text: KAITO: Look at the primary conduits rising into the smog. Every gigawatt generated by these reactors is channeled upward to sustain the Citadel's sky shields.

speaker: TITAN
text: TITAN: Geothermal siphons and heavy magnetic containment coils. The occupation runs this foundry on slave labor and forced quotas. It is built to endure hell... but it wasn't built to endure us.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: OCEANUS: They drained three subterranean aquifers to cool these turbines. The heat here is choking the entire district above. When we smash the coolant valves, the river will reclaim its bed.

speaker: AURA
text: AURA: The frequency from the central turbine is deafening... a brutal, grinding dissonance. But beneath the noise, I can hear the harmonic fault line in the magnetic lattice.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: MIRAGE: Automated defense turrets and molten slag sluices line the perimeter catwalks. I've mapped a path across the upper coolant conduits. Fast, silent, and hot.

speaker: SURYA
text: SURYA // COMMS: My solar bulwark will insulate the squad against initial radiation pulses. But once you breach the reactor core, the overload cascade will be irreversible. You'll have minutes to reach the extraction gantry.

speaker: TITAN
text: TITAN: Let it burn. When that reactor pops, the Citadel's invincible shield drops with it. The occupation will have nowhere left to hide.

speaker: KAITO
text: KAITO: Sever the coolant conduits. Overload the plasma reactor. Break their sky-shields and shatter their throne. Axiom Force—drop in!
